text:
To analyze dozens of competing SaaS websites without manually copying their content,

Use Firecrawl, it turns websites into structured data that you can process and analyze.

Useful for researching competitors' landing pages, content strategies and website structures.

#SEO #MarketingTools #SaaS

Your SaaS website pages need Indexing

PrimeIndexer helps submit URLs for indexing, making it useful to explore when managing multiple pages.

Just remember: getting a URL submitted doesn't guarantee Google will crawl, index or rank it.

#SEO #TechnicalSEO #SaaS #BuildInPublic #IndieHacker

Your SaaS users can create some of the most convincing marketing content.

Ask five happy users of your SaaS about their experience. Record their answers and turn them short clips, testimonials or case studies.

People often trust another user's experience

#SaaS #BuildInPublic #IndieHacker

Remember when link building meant mass guest posts, directory submissions, PBNs and exchanges?

That approach is losing its appeal. 

For your SaaS website, build relationships, earn real recommendations and creating useful resources are better strategies.

#SEO  #LinkBuilding #IndieHacker

A small SaaS website doesn't need to compete for every popular keyword.

LowFruits helps find search terms with weaker competition.

These terms can be a better starting point for websites without the authority or resources to compete against established brands.

#SEO #BuildInPublic #IndieHacker
